mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation requiring monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy change exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime (UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), a declining unemployment rate signals improved labor conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing output and supply chain strength, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity and economic confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply expansion regime (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly), a sustained increase in industrial production signals robust output growth that boosts corporate margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal synchronized demand-supply expansion that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
